ideas.pitch: An interactive 3D digital twin of the local university campus visualizing energy consumption anomalies and real-time foot traffic data.
ideas.title: DearbornXR Campus Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven success of combining 3D spatial visualization with anomaly detection, which historically wins hardware and immersive tracks.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent network traffic simulator that renders active DDoS mitigation and cyber attack vectors in an interactive 3D environment.
ideas.title: ConjureNet Security Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the 'Conjure Reality' theme by materializing invisible network packets into physical-looking 3D hazards, a proven winner at security-focused events.

ideas.pitch: A webcam-based biomechanical feedback engine that extracts real-time skeletal and joint landmarks to correct user posture during physical therapy exercises.
ideas.title: PoseStream AR Coach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Relying on a robust, working MediaPipe pipeline guarantees a reliable live demo, which judges heavily favor over vaporware.

ideas.pitch: An augmented reality assembly instruction helper that uses spatial anchors to guide factory workers through complex wiring tasks in real-time.
ideas.title: AutoXR Manufacturing Floor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to the industrial automation and manufacturing heritage of Dearborn, Michigan.

ideas.pitch: A data-engineering dashboard processing regional weather sensor feeds to predict power grid strain and visualize failure points in 3D.
ideas.title: EcoGrid Arctic Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard data engineering with a polished visualization interface, directly mimicking past hackathon prize-winning criteria.
